params.name: SLOT
params.label: Panel width
params.note: screen pixels per gangway panel — the unit of distance the lean is measured in

params.name: DECK
params.label: Deck row
params.note: screen row of the gangway's walking surface at the pin

params.name: TRUSS
params.label: Truss depth
params.note: rows from the walking surface down to the bottom chord

params.name: TUBE
params.label: Gauge height
params.note: rows of the lean gauge slung under the deck

params.name: HANG
params.label: Gauge gap
params.note: gap between the bottom chord and the lean gauge

params.name: SWING
params.label: Tip swing
params.note: pixels the tip rises or falls at the level's biggest lean

params.name: STEPS
params.label: Walk frames
params.note: frames for a walk, a climb or a crossing

params.name: CAR_STEPS
params.label: Lamp car frames
params.note: frames for the lamp car's own step
